shipTerminal.name: Grand Turk Cruise Center
shipTerminal.description: The cruise ship terminal at the south-west of the island, with shops, the beach and the pier. Return to Ship routes you here - allow plenty of time before all-aboard.
shipTerminal.accessNotes: Return-to-ship endpoint is PROVISIONAL until the approved terminal approach point is confirmed (OD-02).

destinations.name: Governor's Beach
destinations.description: A wide white-sand beach with clear turquoise water and shade trees, popular for swimming and relaxing. One of the closest beaches to the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Pillory Beach
destinations.description: A calm, sandy beach north of Cockburn Town with good snorkelling close to shore.

destinations.name: Osprey Beach
destinations.description: A small beach along the Cockburn Town waterfront, beside historic Front Street.

destinations.name: Boaby Rock Beach
destinations.description: A quieter beach on the south-east of the island with rocky outcrops and open views.

destinations.name: White Sands Beach
destinations.description: A secluded stretch of sand at the southern end of Grand Turk.

destinations.name: Cockburn Town
destinations.description: The capital of the Turks and Caicos Islands, with colonial-era buildings, churches and the waterfront along Front Street and Duke Street.

destinations.name: Grand Turk Lighthouse
destinations.description: The historic cast-iron lighthouse at the island's northern tip, overlooking the reef and the Atlantic.

destinations.name: Front Street
destinations.description: The historic waterfront street of Cockburn Town, lined with old Bermudian-style buildings.

destinations.name: Turks & Caicos National Museum
destinations.description: The national museum on Front Street, covering the islands' natural and cultural history.

destinations.name: Her Majesty's Prison
destinations.description: A historic former prison building in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: St. Mary's Pro-Cathedral
destinations.description: A historic Anglican church near the Cockburn Town waterfront.

destinations.name: St. Thomas Anglican Church
destinations.description: One of the oldest church sites on Grand Turk, north of the town centre.

destinations.name: Columbus Landfall National Park
destinations.description: A protected marine park along the west coast, commemorating one of the proposed landfall sites of Columbus in 1492.

destinations.name: Waterloo (Governor's Residence)
destinations.description: The official residence of the Governor. View from outside only - not open to visitors.

destinations.name: Odd Fellows Lodge
destinations.description: A historic lodge building in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Victoria Public Library
destinations.description: A historic public library building in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Town Salina
destinations.description: A historic salt pond behind Cockburn Town, a reminder of the island's salt-raking past and a place to spot wading birds.

destinations.name: Red Salina
destinations.description: A large salt pond in the south of the island, home to shorebirds and occasionally flamingos.

destinations.name: Hawks Nest Salina
destinations.description: A salt pond and wetland on the south-east of the island, good for birdwatching.

destinations.name: North Creek
destinations.description: A sheltered inland lagoon in the north of the island, lined with mangroves.

destinations.name: Gibbs Cay
destinations.description: A small uninhabited cay east of Grand Turk, reached only by boat tour. Shown for information - it cannot be reached on foot.

destinations.name: JAGS McCartney Airport
destinations.description: Grand Turk's airport, between Cockburn Town and the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Margaritaville Grand Turk
destinations.description: A large beach bar and restaurant with a pool, beside the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Jack's Shack
destinations.description: A casual beach bar on the sand, a short walk north of the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: The Sand Bar
destinations.description: A waterfront bar and grill on Duke Street in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Salt Raker Inn
destinations.description: A historic inn with a garden restaurant on the Cockburn Town waterfront.

destinations.name: Bohio Dive Resort
destinations.description: A beachfront resort with restaurant and dive centre on Pillory Beach.
